messages:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts observed for model-serving-prod across eu-central-1. Condition: 5xx_rate > 4% AND p95 latency > 2s for 3m. Pager routed to primary oncall.

jess_oncall: I'm on it. quick health check: nodes are up but a subset of model-runner pods are restarting repeatedly. any recent model or runtime pushes?

harry: pushed micro-optimizer v2.3 (attention tiling) to canary at 07:30 UTC, then to roll-2 at 08:05. Canary looked ok for 90m.

lee: tailing logs from affected pod: ```
2026-03-15T10:12:05Z model-runner[pid=3421]: FATAL: abrt: caught SIGSEGV in attention_tiler
2026-03-15T10:12:05Z model-runner[pid=3421]: PC=0x7f8dbe6a in tiled_attention::run
2026-03-15T10:12:05Z model-runner[pid=3421]: stack: tiled_attention+0x6a
```
This looks like segmentation faults in the tiled attention path.

amira: gateway traces show a correlation: requests with seq_len > 6k spike the faults, also dynamic batching windows expand there.

jess_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) divert heavy-context traffic to fallback model 2) disable dynamic batching on production 3) set ATTENTION_MODE=compat on live nodes. I'll coordinate.

deploy-bot: Routing change queued: add rule heavy-context -> model-7b-fallback at 30% traffic. Job id 8421.

lee: manually set `dynamic_batching=false` on model-runner config for prod. Pushing restart to 5 nodes in staggered fashion.

harry: i'll flip the env var `ATTN_TILE_MODE=SAFE` via rolling env update, that switches to scalar attention implementation. pushing now.

pager: 12:18 PM 1 EST - Pager note: impact concentrated on long prompts and streaming sessions. Affected customers: data-insights, retailalpha. Estimated affected qps ~9%.

jess_oncall: after routing + batching changes, 5xx rate down from 5.9% to 2.6% in the last 5m. continuing slow restarts.

lee: found a core dump, uploaded to s3: s3://cores/1764567123/pod-3421.core. gdb bt shows: ```
#0  tiled_attention::compute+0x1f5 (attention_tiler.cpp:412)
#1  model::forward+0x3b (model.cpp:227)
#2  serve_loop+0x14a (serve.cpp:98)
```
there's a null deref in the tile index calc when seq_len % tile_size != 0.

harry: that matches a repro I ran locally with seq_len 6143. tile_size was 64 and boundary math returned an uninitialized pointer. going to craft a guarded patch to validate indices.

amira: observability note: p95 token generation time for >6k requests spiked and correlates with bursts in KV cache mem usage. KV cache growth looks superlinear for some sessions.

jess_oncall: next mitigations: 1) ban seq_len > 8k at gateway for 30m with user-facing 400 + descriptive message, 2) enable fallback attention implementation via env, 3) schedule immediate hotfix PR. Agree?

harry: agree. creating hotfix now. will include bounds check and unit test.

deploy-bot: Gateway rule applied: max_seq_len=8192; requests exceeding limit will receive 413. Rule id 9983.

jess_oncall: customer comms: posting incident ack to affected teams, put a banner in status with ETA 3h for hotfix. amira please help with targeted outreach.

amira: emailed SEs for enterprise customers and opened support tickets: INC-1764567123.

lee: after the env switch to SAFE mode, crash loop stopped on nodes we updated. Rolling update to remaining nodes in progress. 5xx rate now at 0.7%.

harry: hotfix PR created: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/1124 - fixes tile index, adds seqlen alignment tests, and forces null-checks. requesting expedited review.

jess_oncall: handoff: I'll remain monitoring for 1h to ensure stability, then transition to postmortem. @harry own the RCA and hotfix merging, @lee own core dump analysis and monitoring dashboards, @amira handle customer follow-ups.

pager: 12:46 PM 1 EST - Update: incident severity SEV2. Duration so far 00:33. No data exfiltration, degraded service for long-context streaming.

amira: customers confirmed degraded behavior, some accepted temporary workaround to chunk inputs <8k. enterprise accounts asked for rollback of v2.3 until patch lands.

jess_oncall: action items captured in incident doc: https://incidents.redwood.example/1764567123. Items: revert v2.3 if hotfix not live in 3h, add tile-size alignment test to CI, add KV cache OOM guard and per-request mem cap, update runbook with `ATTN_TILE_MODE=SAFE` quick switch.

harry: I'll aim to merge and deploy hotfix within 2h. adding extra telemetry around tile boundary math.

jess_oncall: closing live mitigation. If error rate regresses ping #incidents and I'll escalate. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
